name: Greater Spit Poison (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Poison (bite), Ability Focus (poison), Improved Spit Poison, spit or spit poison

Benefit(s): You can spit your venom up to an additional 90 feet as a standard action or up to 30 feet as an immediate action.
